edit_summary.reason: Increase the hovering penalty from -0.5 to -2.0 per step when |vy|<0.1 and distance is not decreasing, to make hovering more costly. Add a distance threshold to the main engine reward: the +2.0 reward only applies when distance < 0.5 (close to pad). This prevents the policy from collecting engine rewards while far from the pad. Keep all other components unchanged. The goal is to force the policy to descend to the pad before it can collect significant engine rewards, and to make hovering unprofitable.
preserved_design: descent reward: 0.5*(prev_vy - vy) when m_power>0 and vy<0
progress-conditioned main engine reward: +2.0 when m_power>0 and distance decreasing
changed_design: hovering penalty: increased from -0.5 to -2.0 per step when |vy|<0.1 and distance >= previous_distance
main engine reward: added distance threshold (distance < 0.5) so that +2.0 only applies when close to pad
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make main engine reward conditional on vy<0 (failed pattern from iter_002 to iter_003).
Do not reduce progress shaping strength (failed pattern from iter_000 to iter_001).
Do not add a reward for doing nothing (action 0).
Do not add a reward for orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) unless necessary.
Do not remove the progress-conditioned main engine reward; instead, add a distance threshold.
